clue.text: Books for more than one opera

definitions.text: Books for more than one opera

parts.words: Books for more than one opera
parts.note: the words for an opera's text, written in the plural because several operas are meant, read as a plain description

explanation.surface: A shopper asks for reading matter covering several operas.
explanation.definitionFit: The text of an opera is its libretto, and the Italian plural covers the words of several operas.

parts.note: he is the pronoun for a man
LP, a long-playing record

explanation.surface: Someone backs a fellow who has cut a record.
explanation.definitionFit: To support someone is to help them; the two verbs are synonyms.

definitions.meaning: fast in the sense of firmly fixed and steady
a set of racehorses kept by one owner or trainer

explanation.definitionFit: Something firmly fixed is steady, and a racing yard's string of runners is collectively named after their building.

parts.note: to command is to order
a duck in cricket is a score of nothing, shaped like the letter O

explanation.surface: A marine is told to get his head down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Duck' looks like a verb telling the marine to stoop; it is the cricket zero, O.
explanation.definitionFit: Royal Marines are trained as amphibious assault troops of the specialised kind, an example of the type.

clue.text: It's the case made out for good taste

indicators.note: made out suggests the letters are worked into a fresh shape, signalling a rearrangement

explanation.surface: An argument is presented in favour of refinement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'made out' rearranges the letters of ITS THE CASE.
explanation.definitionFit: Aesthetics is the study and sense of beauty, so good taste in art falls under it.

parts.note: reads as thwarting intruders, but a foil is a sword used in a sport, and keeping trespassers out of land means putting a barrier round it

explanation.definitionFit: Duelling with foils is a sport, and enclosing land with railings keeps trespassers out; both senses share one verb.

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the tree's letters go round the match

parts.note: the fir is a conifer
a vesta is an old name for a short match

explanation.surface: A top-rated tree has no match.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' reads as lacking, but here keeps its old sense of outside, so the tree's letters surround the match; a vesta is an old word for a short match.
explanation.definitionFit: Hotels and restaurants are graded by stars, and the top rating is the highest grade.

clue.text: Raw recruit that is seen below 22 across

indicators.note: in a down clue, what is seen below follows the other piece

parts.note: the answer to 22 across is a chessman, whose other name is rook
i.e. abbreviates id est, that is

explanation.surface: A new soldier is spotted beneath a fortress.
explanation.definitionFit: A novice in the army or any team is a newcomer still learning the job.

definitions.meaning: a key is something that unlocks
in cricket, a batsman who starts the innings

explanation.definitionFit: A key is a device that unlocks doors, and the first two batsmen in cricket begin the innings.

parts.note: pro means for, in favour of

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A position is sought for a party's head.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Post' reads as a job; it is a support, as for a roof.
explanation.definitionFit: A post is an upright support, like a beam holding up a ceiling.

parts.note: split into sweep and stake, a stake being a pole: a pole for sweeping

explanation.definitionFit: A long handle on a brush used for sweeping is a pole, the stake of the clue.

clue.text: Female embraced by one female deity or another

indicators.note: embraced by means held inside another piece

parts.note: Ate is the Greek goddess of folly and ruin
a hen is a female bird

explanation.surface: A woman is hugged by one goddess or another.
explanation.walkthrough: 'or another' looks like part of the wordplay; it is the definition: another goddess.
explanation.definitionFit: Athene is a second Greek goddess, of wisdom, so she is another female deity beside Ate.

parts.note: reads as a large estate, but describes the quality of being able to extend or stretch

explanation.definitionFit: Stretchiness is a physical property, the capacity of a material to extend and recover.

clue.text: Hint union is in trouble and about to wind up

indicators.note: about means around, the jumbled letters going round the next piece
a union in trouble is in disarray, so its letters are jumbled

parts.note: to wind up is to end

explanation.surface: Someone hints that the union is struggling and close to folding.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in trouble' rearranges UNION to INNUO, which goes 'about' END.
explanation.definitionFit: An innuendo is an indirect hint or insinuation, usually a suggestive one.

clue.text: Animal whose food is superior to other animals

definitions.text: Animal whose food is superior to other animals

parts.words: Animal whose food is superior to other animals
parts.note: superior here means higher up, the tall creature feeding on treetop leaves others cannot reach

explanation.definitionFit: This long-necked African animal browses on high acacia leaves beyond other grazers' reach.

clue.text: Switches on for one daily period

indicators.note: switches means changes about, signalling a rearrangement of the letters

explanation.surface: Someone turns things on for one part of the day.
explanation.definitionFit: The morning before midday is a regular part of each day.

clue.text: Big chap who was catapulted to fame

definitions.text: Big chap who was catapulted to fame

parts.words: Big chap who was catapulted to fame
parts.note: the giant felled by David's sling stone, so it was a catapult that made his name

explanation.definitionFit: The Philistine giant of the Bible became famous for being killed by David with a sling.

definitions.meaning: to discuss is to go over a matter in conversation
when a speech is finished, the talk is over

explanation.definitionFit: To discuss something is to chew it over, and a finished lecture means the speaking has ended.

indicators.note: non- says the letter after it is missing from the plants

parts.note: annuals are plants that live a single year

explanation.surface: Records are kept of plants not suited to the upper class.
explanation.walkthrough: 'non-U' looks like the British phrase for not upper-class; it says remove U from ANNUALS.
explanation.definitionFit: Annals are year-by-year historical records.

parts.note: the players in a show are its cast
an iron is a golf club

explanation.surface: Powerful actors are signing up with a club.
explanation.definitionFit: Something unbreakable or rigid is strong, like the metal it is named after.

clue.text: Title father comes up with for an ancestor

indicators.note: in a down clue, coming up means reading from the bottom, so the run is turned backwards

parts.note: a title is a name
pa is a familiar word for father

explanation.surface: Dad thinks of a name for a forebear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'comes up' reverses NAMEPA in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: A primate forerunner of humans was imagined as half ape, half human, an early ancestor.

definitions.meaning: the chess piece also called the rook
a fortified place, a stronghold built for defence

explanation.definitionFit: The rook in chess goes by another name, and a fortified stronghold is the same word.

definitions.meaning: the word said when raising a glass as a toast

explanation.definitionFit: Shouts of applause share a word with the toast drinkers give to each other's health.

indicators.note: spread means the letters are spread about and rearranged, playing on a newspaper's centre spread

explanation.surface: A section of a newspaper's middle double page.
explanation.definitionFit: A percentage is a proportion or share of a whole.

parts.note: top means best

explanation.surface: Ending up runner-up to the champion.
explanation.definitionFit: To halt is to bring something to an end; the verbs are synonyms.

parts.note: Sc is the abbreviation for science, as in BSc
an is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A science paper is duplicated digitally.
explanation.definitionFit: To digitise a page with a scanner is to copy it electronically.

clue.text: Beating that leaves marks on the skin?

definitions.meaning: a rhythmic drumbeat, as in a military drum signal

definitions.text: that leaves marks on the skin?
definitions.meaning: an inked design pricked into the skin; the drum skin is also hinted at

explanation.definitionFit: A drum signal summoning soldiers and an inked skin design share one word.

indicators.note: rounds means goes round the next piece

parts.note: a steamer is a ship

indicators.note: the end of a word is its last letter

explanation.surface: A flagship circles the end of a pier.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flagship' splits: 'Flag' is the definition and 'ship' is STEAMER, which 'rounds' R, the 'end of' pier.
explanation.definitionFit: A streamer is a long narrow flag or pennant.
